_about: The titles side by side (plan 7.6b): the titles the texts use, and where each is used and of whom, each in the passages' own words (Berean Standard Bible, every quotation machine-checked; counts from a search of the whole Berean), with Alike and Different in the site's voice. Drafted by Claude Opus; every line read by the nine-reader panel (Sonnet): 6 accepted, 8 revised. Says of whom a text uses a title only as that text names them. Takes no interpretive stance.
columns_note: The Law & history: Genesis to Esther. Psalms & wisdom: Job to the Song of Solomon. The Prophets: Isaiah to Malachi.

rows.title: Anointed, Messiah, Christ

The Law & history: Has not the LORD anointed you ruler over His inheritance?
Surely here before the LORD is His anointed.
the one anointed by the God of Jacob
Psalms & wisdom: against the LORD and against His Anointed One
He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever
therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy
I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him
Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!
The Prophets: This is what the LORD says to Cyrus His anointed
the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor
The LORD's anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits
You were anointed as a guardian cherub
These are the two anointed ones who are standing beside the Lord of all the earth
Gospels & Acts: We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ)
I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming
were all wondering in their hearts if John could be the Christ
You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
The Spirit of the Lord is on Me, because He has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor
For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,' and will deceive many.
The letters: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures
therefore God, Your God, has anointed You above Your companions with the oil of joy
the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ
Revelation: the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ
reigned with Christ for a thousand years

rows.alike: John glosses one word with the other, and says so himself: 'the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ)' (John 1:41), 'Messiah” (called Christ)' (John 4:25). Across the columns the word is often possessive, someone anointed by or belonging to God: 'the LORD's anointed' (1 Samuel 24:6), 'His Anointed One' (Psalm 2:2), 'His Christ' (Revelation 11:15).
rows.different: It is said of a pillar (Genesis 31:13), of 'the anointed priest' (Leviticus 4:3), of Saul ('my master, the LORD's anointed', 1 Samuel 24:6), of David ('the one anointed by the God of Jacob', 2 Samuel 23:1; 'to David and his descendants forever', Psalm 18:50), of Cyrus ('Cyrus His anointed', Isaiah 45:1), of the one addressed in 'You were anointed as a guardian cherub' (Ezekiel 28:14) and of 'two anointed ones' (Zechariah 4:14), while Psalm 2:2 and Daniel 9:25 ('the Messiah, the Prince') name no one. In the Gospels & Acts (85 verses) people wonder 'if John could be the Christ' (Luke 3:15), Peter says to Jesus 'You are the Christ' (Matthew 16:16) and Jesus warns that 'many will come in My name' claiming to be the Christ (Matthew 24:5); in the letters (432 verses) it is joined to Jesus' name, as in 'Jesus Christ our Lord' (Romans 1:4), and 2 Corinthians 1:21 says of believers 'He anointed us'.

rows.title: Son of David

The Law & history: Now Solomon son of David established himself securely over his kingdom
a servant of Solomon son of David
the temple built by Solomon son of David king of Israel
Psalms & wisdom: These are the proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel
These are the words of the Teacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem
Gospels & Acts: the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham
Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife
Have mercy on us, Son of David!
Could this be the Son of David?
Hosanna to the Son of David!
How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?

rows.alike: Every use calls someone David's son, in the same words: 'Solomon son of David' (2 Chronicles 1:1), 'the Teacher, the son of David' (Ecclesiastes 1:1), 'Jesus Christ, the son of David' (Matthew 1:1).
rows.different: In Chronicles and Proverbs it is Solomon ('Solomon son of David, king of Israel', Proverbs 1:1), Ecclesiastes 1:1 gives it to 'the Teacher' without a name, and an angel calls Joseph 'son of David' (Matthew 1:20). In the Gospels it is said to or of Jesus by two blind men ('Have mercy on us, Son of David!', Matthew 9:27), by crowds who ask 'Could this be the Son of David?' (Matthew 12:23) and shout 'Hosanna to the Son of David!' (Matthew 21:9), and Jesus asks 'How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?' (Mark 12:35).

rows.title: King of Israel, King of the Jews

The Law & history: Against whom has the king of Israel come out?
How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today!
Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel
Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel
Surely this is the king of Israel!
Psalms & wisdom: Solomon son of David, king of Israel
The Prophets: Pekah son of Remaliah the king of Israel
Jeroboam son of Jehoash, king of Israel
When the day dawns, the king of Israel will be utterly cut off.
Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent word to Jeroboam king of Israel
Gospels & Acts: Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews?
So Pilate questioned Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!
He is the King of Israel! Let Him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,' but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.'

rows.alike: Every use names one person as king over a people: 'Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel' (1 Kings 16:29), 'Solomon son of David, king of Israel' (Proverbs 1:1), 'THE KING OF THE JEWS' (Mark 15:26).
rows.different: In the Law & history (119 verses) and the Prophets (6 verses) it is the title of the reigning king of the northern kingdom or of all Israel: David says it to Saul (1 Samuel 24:14), Michal says it of David (2 Samuel 6:20), and it is said of Nadab, Ahab, Pekah and Jeroboam, while in 1 Kings 22:32 chariot commanders take Jehoshaphat for 'the king of Israel'. In the Gospels it is said only of Jesus, and always by others: Magi ask for 'the One who has been born King of the Jews' (Matthew 2:2), Pilate asks 'Are You the King of the Jews?' and Jesus replies 'You have said so' (Mark 15:2), Nathanael says 'You are the King of Israel!' (John 1:49), mockers at the cross say 'He is the King of Israel!' (Matthew 27:42), and the chief priests tell Pilate of the notice 'Do not write' it, 'but only that He said' it (John 19:19-21).

rows.title: Son of Man

The Law & history: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind.
Psalms & wisdom: the son of man, who is but a worm!
what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
Let Your hand be upon the man at Your right hand, on the son of man You have raised up for Yourself.
O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?
The Prophets: of a son of man who withers like grass
Son of man,” He said to me, “stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.
Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel.
I saw One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven
Son of man,” he said to me, “understand that the vision concerns the time of the end.
Gospels & Acts: but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head
the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins
Who do people say the Son of Man is?
For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.
you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven
I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.
The letters: What is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
Revelation: and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe
seated on the cloud was One like the Son of Man, with a golden crown on His head

rows.alike: The same words run through every column. In the Law, the Psalms and Isaiah they stand in parallel with 'man' ('what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?', Psalm 8:4, quoted in Hebrews 2:6), and Daniel 7:13 and Revelation 1:13 and 14:14 share the wording 'One like the Son of Man'.
rows.different: Numbers 23:19 and Psalm 8:4 use it of human beings ('God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man'), Psalm 80:17 of 'the man at Your right hand', Ezekiel is addressed by it throughout ('“Son of man,” He said to me', Ezekiel 2:1; 98 verses in the Prophets), and so is Daniel, by Gabriel (Daniel 8:16-17), while the 'One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven' of Daniel 7:13 is not named. In the Gospels & Acts (79 verses) it is in the sayings of Jesus ('the Son of Man has no place to lay His head', Matthew 8:20; 'the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins', Mark 2:10), Jesus asks His disciples 'Who do people say the Son of Man is?' (Matthew 16:13), and Stephen says 'I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God' (Acts 7:56).

rows.title: Son of God, My Son

The Law & history: the sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful
according to the number of the sons of God
I will be his Father, and he will be My son.
Psalms & wisdom: One day the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD
while the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.
The Prophets: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son.
the fourth looks like a son of the gods!
Gospels & Acts: This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
the son of Adam, the son of God.
Truly this man was the Son of God!
that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God
As it is written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.'
The letters: declared with power to be the Son of God by His resurrection from the dead
For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.
I will be His Father, and He will be My Son
like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time
If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God
Revelation: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire

rows.alike: Each use names someone as God's son or as sons of God, and several are God speaking in the first person: 'I will be his Father, and he will be My son' (2 Samuel 7:14), 'You are My Son; today I have become Your Father' (Psalm 2:7), 'This is My beloved Son' (Matthew 3:17).
rows.different: The plural is said of those who 'came to present themselves before the LORD' with Satan (Job 1:6), of peacemakers (Matthew 5:9) and of 'all who are led by the Spirit of God' (Romans 8:14); 'My son' is said of Israel ('Israel is My firstborn son', Exodus 4:22; Hosea 11:1) and of the descendant promised to David (2 Samuel 7:12-14), Luke 3:38 ends a genealogy with 'the son of Adam, the son of God', and King Nebuchadnezzar says the fourth man in the fire 'looks like a son of the gods' (Daniel 3:24-25). In the Gospels it is said to or of Jesus by a voice from heaven (Matthew 3:17), by the tempter (Matthew 4:3), by unclean spirits (Mark 3:11) and by a centurion ('Truly this man was the Son of God!', Mark 15:39), John writes 'that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God' (John 20:31), and Acts 13:33 and Hebrews 1:5 quote Psalm 2:7 of him.

rows.title: My Servant

The Law & history: for the sake of My servant Abraham
But this is not so with My servant Moses; he is faithful in all My house.
But because My servant Caleb has a different spirit
Go and tell My servant David
Psalms & wisdom: Have you considered My servant Job?
I have found My servant David
The Prophets: Just as My servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years
But you, O Israel, My servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen
Here is My Servant, whom I uphold, My Chosen One, in whom My soul delights.
You are My Servant, Israel, in whom I will display My glory.
I will send for My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon
I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them.
Gospels & Acts: Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights.
against Your holy servant Jesus, whom You anointed

rows.alike: In each use someone is called God's servant, in God's own words ('My servant Moses', Numbers 12:7; 'My servant Job', Job 1:8) or in words spoken about Him or to Him ('His servant Jesus', Acts 3:13; 'Your holy servant Jesus', Acts 4:27).
rows.different: It is said of Abraham, Moses, Caleb, David, Job and Isaiah, of Nebuchadnezzar ('My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon', Jeremiah 25:9), of Zerubbabel (Haggai 2:23), of Israel and Jacob ('But you, O Israel, My servant', Isaiah 41:8); in Isaiah 42:1 and 52:13 'My Servant' is not named, and Isaiah 49:3 has 'You are My Servant, Israel'. Matthew 12:15-18 quotes the words of Isaiah 42:1 of Jesus, Peter speaks of 'His servant Jesus' (Acts 3:13) and the believers pray of 'Your holy servant Jesus' (Acts 4:27); the other verses the search finds, such as the centurion's 'my servant' (Matthew 8:6), are servants of human masters.

rows.title: A prophet like Moses, the Prophet

The Law & history: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to him.
I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brothers. I will put My words in his mouth
Since that time, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face
I too am a prophet like you
Gospels & Acts: Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.
Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.
This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.
For Moses said, ‘The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.
This is the same Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.'

rows.alike: The phrase begins with Moses' words 'a prophet like me from among your brothers' (Deuteronomy 18:15), which Acts 3:22 and 7:37 repeat, and in John people ask about or name 'the Prophet' with the article: 'Are you the Prophet?' (John 1:21), 'This is truly the Prophet.' (John 7:40).
rows.different: Deuteronomy 18:15-18 names no one and Deuteronomy 34:10 says 'no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses'; in 1 Kings 13:18 an old prophet says 'I too am a prophet like you' to the man of God, and the text adds 'The old prophet was lying to him'. John answers 'No' when asked if he is the Prophet (John 1:19-21), crowds say of Jesus 'Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world' (John 6:14) and 'This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee' (Matthew 21:11), Peter quotes Moses' words (Acts 3:22), and Stephen quotes them (Acts 7:37); many of the other verses with 'the prophet' (64 in the Law & history, 59 in the Prophets) use it as the ordinary word for a named prophet.

rows.title: A priest like Melchizedek

The Law & history: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine-since he was priest of God Most High-
Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
Psalms & wisdom: You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
The letters: You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
and was designated by God as high priest in the order of Melchizedek
where Jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time
one in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron
if another priest like Melchizedek appears

rows.alike: Every use goes back to Melchizedek, 'king of Salem' and 'priest of God Most High' (Genesis 14:18), and Psalm 110:4 and Hebrews share the words 'a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek'.
rows.different: Genesis 14 is about Melchizedek himself, who blesses Abram and receives 'a tenth of everything' (Genesis 14:20); Psalm 110:4 says 'You are a priest forever' to one it does not name. Hebrews 5:5-6 has it said to Christ, Hebrews 6:20 names 'Jesus our forerunner', Hebrews 7:3 says of Melchizedek that 'like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time', and the words 'another priest like Melchizedek' occur only in Hebrews 7:15.

rows.title: Shepherd

The Law & history: the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day
Doeg the Edomite, the chief shepherd for Saul
You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.
Psalms & wisdom: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock
The Prophets: He tends His flock like a shepherd
who says of Cyrus, ‘My shepherd will fulfill all that I desire,'
I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them.
Awake, O sword, against My Shepherd, against the man who is My Companion
Gospels & Acts: I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.
The letters: our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep
but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls
And when the Chief Shepherd appears
Revelation: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd.

rows.alike: Apart from Doeg, 'the chief shepherd for Saul' (1 Samuel 21:7), most uses make people the flock and someone their shepherd: 'who leads Joseph like a flock' (Psalm 80:1), 'he will feed them' (Ezekiel 34:23), 'The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep' (John 10:11).
rows.different: The shepherd is God in Genesis 48:15 ('the God who has been my shepherd'), Psalm 23:1 ('The LORD is my shepherd') and Psalm 80:1, the one who 'tends His flock like a shepherd' in Isaiah 40:11, David in 2 Samuel 5:2 and Ezekiel 34:23 ('one shepherd, My servant David'), Cyrus in Isaiah 44:28, Death in Psalm 49:14, and 'the man who is My Companion' in Zechariah 13:7. Jesus quotes Zechariah's words in Matthew 26:31 ('This very night you will all fall away on account of Me'), says 'I am the good shepherd' (John 10:11), Hebrews 13:20 names 'our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep', and Revelation 7:17 says 'the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd'.

rows.title: Branch, Shoot, Root

The Prophets: Then a shoot will spring up from the stump of Jesse, and a Branch from his roots will bear fruit.
On that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples.
they are the branch of My planting
I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and He will reign wisely as King
For behold, I am going to bring My servant, the Branch.
Here is a man whose name is the Branch, and He will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD.
The letters: The Root of Jesse will appear, One who will arise to rule over the Gentiles
Revelation: the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll
I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David

rows.alike: Each uses a word from a plant -- shoot, Branch, Root -- for a person or a people, and most tie it to Jesse or David: 'a shoot will spring up from the stump of Jesse' (Isaiah 11:1), 'for David a righteous Branch' (Jeremiah 23:5), 'the Root and the Offspring of David' (Revelation 22:16).
rows.different: Isaiah 11:1 and Jeremiah 23:5 name no one beyond the line of Jesse and David, and Isaiah 60:21 says of the people 'they are the branch of My planting'; Zechariah 3:8, addressed to 'high priest Joshua', has 'My servant, the Branch', and Zechariah 6:11-12, said to Joshua, has 'Here is a man whose name is the Branch' who 'will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD'. Romans 15:12 quotes Isaiah's 'The Root of Jesse', an elder in Revelation 5:5 speaks of 'the Root of David', and in Revelation 22:16 the speaker says 'I, Jesus' and 'I am the Root and the Offspring of David'.

rows.title: The Lamb

The Law & history: God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.
Your lamb must be an unblemished year-old male
Then he is to slaughter the lamb in the sanctuary area
The Prophets: The wolf will live with the lamb
He was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is silent, so He did not open His mouth.
For I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter
Gospels & Acts: Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so He did not open His mouth
who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?
The letters: For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot
Revelation: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne
Worthy is the Lamb who was slain
For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd.
They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings
because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple
The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city

rows.alike: In the Law the lamb is an animal for offering, 'the lamb for the burnt offering' (Genesis 22:8) and 'the Passover lamb' (Exodus 12:21), and many later uses keep the words of slaughter and offering: 'led like a lamb to the slaughter' (Isaiah 53:7), 'our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed' (1 Corinthians 5:7), 'a Lamb who appeared to have been slain' (Revelation 5:6).
rows.different: Isaiah 53:7 says 'He was led like a lamb to the slaughter' without naming him, Jeremiah says of himself 'I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter' (Jeremiah 11:19), and in Acts 8:34 the eunuch reading Isaiah asks 'who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?', and Philip 'told him the good news about Jesus' (Acts 8:35). John, seeing Jesus, says 'Look, the Lamb of God' (John 1:29, 36), 1 Corinthians 5:7 calls Christ 'our Passover lamb', and in Revelation (32 verses) the Lamb is on the throne with God ('The throne of God and of the Lamb', Revelation 22:3), while Isaiah 11:6 has the lamb as an animal living with the wolf.

rows.title: The stone, the cornerstone

Psalms & wisdom: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
The Prophets: And He will be a sanctuary-but to both houses of Israel a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense
See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation
No one shall retrieve from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone
As you watched, a stone was cut out, but not by human hands.
The cornerstone will come from Judah
Gospels & Acts: Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.'
The letters: See, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense
with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone
See, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone
To you who believe, then, this stone is precious.
A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.

rows.alike: Several uses are of a stone or cornerstone, and many in the Gospels, Acts and letters repeat the earlier texts' words: Psalm 118:22's 'The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone' (Matthew 21:42; Acts 4:11; 1 Peter 2:7) and Isaiah's 'a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense' and 'I lay a stone in Zion' (Romans 9:33; 1 Peter 2:6, 8).
rows.different: Job 38:6 is the cornerstone of the earth (Job 38:4), Jeremiah 51:26 is said against Babylon, Isaiah 8:14 says 'He will be a sanctuary' and 'a stone of stumbling', Isaiah 28:16 has the Lord GOD say 'I lay a stone in Zion', Daniel 2:34 has 'a stone was cut out, but not by human hands', and Psalm 118:22 names no one. Jesus quotes Psalm 118:22 to his hearers (Matthew 21:42), Peter says 'This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected' (Acts 4:8-11), and Ephesians 2:20 has 'Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone'.

rows.title: Immanuel

The Prophets: Behold, the virgin will be with child and give birth to a son, and will call Him Immanuel.
its spreading streams will cover your entire land, O Immanuel!
Gospels & Acts: and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us”).

rows.alike: The name is the same in all three verses, and Matthew 1:23 gives its meaning: '(which means, “God with us”)'.
rows.different: Isaiah 7:14 is a sign given in the days of Ahaz (Isaiah 7:1), and Isaiah 8:8 addresses the land as 'your entire land, O Immanuel!'; Matthew 1:22-23 quotes Isaiah 7:14 of the son born to Mary. Where Isaiah 7:14 has 'and will call Him Immanuel', Matthew 1:23 has 'and they will call Him Immanuel'.

rows.title: The Holy One

The Law & history: Against the Holy One of Israel!
Psalms & wisdom: that I have not denied the words of the Holy One
For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding
The Prophets: they have despised the Holy One of Israel
To whom will you liken Me, or who is My equal?” asks the Holy One.
For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior
Thus says the LORD, the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel, to Him who was despised and abhorred by the nation
For I am God and not man-the Holy One among you
God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran.
Gospels & Acts: What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are-the Holy One of God!
So the Holy One to be born will be called the Son of God.
We believe and know that You are the Holy One of God.
nor will You let Your Holy One see decay
You will not let Your Holy One see decay.
The letters: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One

rows.alike: Each use names one as 'the Holy One' (Psalm 106:16 has 'the holy one of the LORD'), in the Prophets most often 'the Holy One of Israel' (Isaiah 1:4; 34 verses in the Prophets), and Psalm 16:10's 'Your Holy One see decay' is quoted in Acts 2:27 and Acts 13:35.
rows.different: In Isaiah and Hosea it is a name of the LORD, and in some verses he speaks it of himself ('For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel', Isaiah 43:3; 'For I am God and not man-the Holy One among you', Hosea 11:9), while Psalm 106:16 calls Aaron 'the holy one of the LORD' and Psalm 16:10 speaks of 'Your Holy One' without a name. In the Gospels a man with an unclean spirit (Mark 1:23-24) and Peter (John 6:68-69) say it to Jesus, the angel says it of the child to be born (Luke 1:35), Peter quotes Psalm 16:10 (Acts 2:27), and 1 John 2:20 speaks of 'an anointing from the Holy One' without naming whom.
